card.name: Capitalized NOTE and brand name pieces
card.fires_on: The word NOTE (or DO) in capitals starting a new sentence after a preparation or use instruction. Also partway through capitalized brand names such as VOCABRIA, ISOLYTE, PROSOL and EXTRANEAL.

modes.label: NOTE after a sentence
modes.description: Capitalized NOTE or DO opening a caution sentence right after a full stop in handling or dosing instructions.
modes.example: << NOTE>>: Parenteral drug products should be inspected

modes.label: Inside capitalized brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps product name, especially IV solutions and newer drugs.

card.plain: It marks capitalized NOTE remarks and the middle of all-caps product names in drug labels.
